text:
MR::collect
Description
This iRules command collects the specified amount of MR message
payload data.
Syntax
MR
::
collect
MR
::
collect
<
collect_bytes
>
MR::collect
Collect the entire payload of the MR message. To stop collecting use
MR::release command. MR_DATA event will be raised on every ingress
invocation of the proxy.
MR::collect <collect_bytes>
Collect bytes of payload of the MR message. If payload is smaller
than collect entire payload. The collected data can be accessed via
the MR::payload command. To stop collecting use MR::release command.
Examples
Related Information
Valid Events:
MR_INGRESS, MR_DATA
